tools.name: appbuilder CLI
tools.purpose: The control plane for the whole loop — plan, scaffold, build, test, review, ship, plus coordination (claim/handoff/ready/release), decision (ADR), doctor, and status. No LLM; it scaffolds, validates, and coordinates.
tools.usage: node cli/appbuilder.js <command>  (run `node cli/appbuilder.js help` for the full verb list)
tools.maintenance: cli/appbuilder.js (router) + cli/lib/*.js (handlers); every artifact-writing verb validates against a contracts/schemas/v1 schema before writing.
alternatives_considered: Hand-editing coordination/artifact state (rejected: must go through the CLI so validation and the gates are enforced)

tools.name: schema-validator
tools.purpose: The single artifact-validation seam: validates JSON and markdown-frontmatter artifacts against contracts/schemas/v1/*.schema.json. Use it instead of hand-rolling validation.
tools.usage: require('core/validation/schema-validator') or the wrappers in cli/lib/validate.js (validateRequirements, validateAdr, ...)
tools.maintenance: core/validation/schema-validator.js — custom recursive validator (no AJV); a future AJV swap changes only this file.

tools.name: template:app
tools.purpose: Scaffold a minimal application skeleton (server + test).

tools.name: template:cli
tools.purpose: Scaffold a zero-dependency Node CLI tool skeleton.

tools.name: template:game
tools.purpose: Scaffold a small game skeleton (game loop + test).

tools.name: template:library
tools.purpose: Scaffold a reusable library skeleton (public API + test).

tools.name: decision (ADR flow)
tools.purpose: Capture an Architecture Decision Record (validated markdown) in vault/framework/decisions/ — the durable home for design decisions.

tools.name: vault (file-based memory)
tools.purpose: The framework's memory store: ADRs (decisions/), lessons (lessons/), known problems, and per-project notes — file-based and greppable, browsable as an Obsidian vault. Consult it before building something new.
tools.usage: Browse vault/framework/ and vault/projects/; ADRs are written via `appbuilder decision add`. Lives on the working branch, never the coordination branch.
